description: This Java source file defines the ShopContentController class, which handles HTTP requests to display content pages based on friendly URLs in a Spring MVC web application. It retrieves content descriptions for a store and prepares page metadata for rendering.

classes.name: ShopContentController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller that manages the display of content pages for the shop, using URL mapping and dependency injection.

methods.name: displayContent
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to display content pages based on a friendly URL, retrieves content info, sets page metadata, and returns the view name.
